_note: The Book (/book/): evergreen buy or gift. Retail links appear automatically once CONFIG.retailers has URLs. buy_url and gift_url: leave empty to use the live Supabase book-checkout function (Larry approved this on Nov 2, 2026): $20 per signed copy plus $8 flat shipping, collected through Stripe Checkout, success page /order-thank-you/. The buttons POST to book-checkout and go to the Stripe url it returns. The old /book/checkout/ page is retired and now redirects to /book/.
buy_body: Order a copy signed by Larry and Ro for $20 plus $8 flat shipping. Add a name for the inscription, or send it as a gift with a short note. Whether you have been fighting for years or just want to stop before it starts, this is a place to begin, together.
group_body: If you are getting copies for a small group, a class or a whole church, order directly from us. Ten copies or a hundred, same conversation.
gift_title: Give it to a couple you love.
gift_body: Know a couple who keeps having the same fight? Send them a signed copy with your note inside. We mail it to the address you enter at checkout.
buy_page_line: Get your signed copy of Never Fight or Argue Again, for yourself or for a couple you love.
